name: razor-root-namespace-regex-and-plain-name
body: RazorCompiler.ResolveRootNamespace finds @namespace with a line-based regex rather than Razor's parser, so a directive inside a Razor comment or code block is still picked up; and with RootNamespace unset it falls back to the plain project name, without the .NET SDK's space-to-underscore replacement. Upgrade to reading the directive from the Razor syntax tree, and match the SDK default, if either case appears in real projects.
